name: K & F Electronics
old_description: Since 1972, K & F Electronics has been a staple in the circuit board world. As a family business passed down through three generations, we've kept our focus on providing top-notch services for everything circuit board related, from design and manufacturing to assembly and even reverse engineering.
about:
K & F Electronics was founded in 1972 in Fraser, Michigan, a suburb of Detroit. It remains a third-generation family-owned business, with the founder's grandson now at the helm. The company began as a single facility focused on integrated circuit board solutions.

Today, K & F operates from its Fraser facility with a team of 27 professionals. It provides end-to-end PCB services: in-house fabrication of single-sided, double-sided, and multilayer rigid boards (up to IPC Class 3), as well as flex and rigid-flex circuits using materials such as FR-4, Rogers, Taconic, Arlon, Nelco, Teflon, polyimide, and aluminum. Assembly capabilities include automated SMT (18,000–30,000 components per hour), through-hole, selective soldering, box build, and hand soldering. The company also offers PCB design, reverse engineering, 3D printing, wire stripping, conformal coating, flying probe testing, and X-ray/AOI inspection. Offshore partnerships supplement high-volume production.

The company serves original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers across sectors that require ITAR-compliant and IPC Class 3 quality, including aerospace, defense, medical, and industrial electronics. Customers range from prototype runs to high-volume orders, with expedited lead times from 24 hours to four weeks.

K & F differentiates itself through an integrated design-fabrication-assembly model, a 1-year warranty on all PCBs and PCBAs, and a reported return rate below 1%. Its motto, “Providing quality today for tomorrow’s technology,” reflects a legacy of reliability and a commitment to domestic PCB production as a PCBAA member.
